scope: research only; no production or architecture changes

verification.dictionary_method: Exhaustive candidate lookup for 10 observed queries against the pinned full dictionary (1253 unique species labels, 926 unique move labels); local replay with union of those candidates, not a full-dictionary CLI run.

limitations: Fitted geometry; no held-out accuracy measurement.
Name suggestions are not calibrated probabilities or exhaustive possible true names.
Move effectiveness label overlaps a candidate region and remains UNKNOWN.
HP association is provisional and only tested in one command layout.
No raw player transcripts or images published.
